glosses: farmer (male or of unspecified gender) (especially in reference to English-speaking countries)

examples.text: Der Farmer säte Weizen auf sein Feld.
examples.en: The farmer sowed his field with wheat.

examples.text: Der Farmer, der in der Nähe wohnte, kam, um Nachforschungen anzustellen.
examples.en: The farmer that lived nearby came to investigate.

examples.text: Manche Farmer schützen ihre Schafe mit Eseln vor wilden Hunden.
examples.en: Some farmers are using donkeys to protect their sheep from wild dogs.
